annotations.title: Pause, resume, stop or answer a search

description: A started search: pause, resume, stop (the leads found are kept and charged), or continue — the answer to a search that asks about a higher price (status asking): it SPENDS the extra credits of get_search's `ask.continue_credits`; show them and pass them as confirm_credits after the user's yes. [REST: POST /api/tasks/{id}/control]

confirm_credits.description: The price in credits the matching quote returned, shown to the user and confirmed by them.

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.

name: control_search
